Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal whitelist gate; returns true for owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/canSale accounts, otherwise delegates to condition().
Public payable transfer path performing unchecked allowance and balance deductions plus _onSaleNum increment and event emission.
Public payable approval that unconditionally overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal sale-condition evaluator reading _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-supplied address and calldata.

Owner-only configuration of sale limits (_saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale).
Owner-only batch transfer looping over recipient array with unchecked balance arithmetic and duplicated events.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist bypass.
Pure CREATE2-style pair address computation used inside ensure().
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance spending and mint backdoors.

edges.reason: require(msg.sender == owner) gates the dangerous delegatecall path.
msg.sender != _from decides whether the caller's allowance is spent.
msg.sender is checked against owner or a hardcoded backdoor address before minting.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates batchSend.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates init configuration.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates setTradeAddress.
owner is assigned directly from the untrusted msg.sender in the constructor.
msg.sender writes its own allowance entry in approve.
transfer forwards msg.sender, _to and _value into transferFrom.
transferFrom requires ensure() to succeed before mutating balances.
ensure() falls back to condition() for non-whitelisted senders.
condition reads _saleNum to bound sales.
condition reads _minSale to reject small transfers.
condition reads _maxSale to reject large transfers.
ensure reads _onSaleNum/canSale whitelist state of _from.
ensure compares _from against the UNI router constant.
ensure compares _from against the mutable tradeAddress whitelist.
transferFrom performs unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value.
transferFrom performs unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value.
transferFrom credits balanceOf[_to] without overflow protection.
batchSend performs unchecked balanceOf arithmetic inside its loop.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] without touching totalSupply.
init writes the _saleNum sale limit.
init writes the _minSale threshold.
init writes the _maxSale threshold.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist bypass.
delegate passes attacker-controlled address a and bytes b into delegatecall.
delegatecall executes foreign code in this storage context, enabling re-entrant calls back into transferFrom/mint paths.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
constructor mints the full supply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
constructor computes totalSupply = _supply*(10**decimals).
constructor grants infinite allowance to the UNI router.
approve overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender].

normalization_plan.reason: _from is the address whose allowance and balance transferFrom mutates.
_to is the credited recipient of the unchecked balance transfer.
_spender indexes the allowance mapping written by approve.
spender is the balanceOf key overwritten by the privileged mint.
addedValue is the unscaled amount assigned to balanceOf[spender].
saleNum is written into the _saleNum state variable by init.
token scales into the _minSale state variable in init.
maxToken scales into the _maxSale state variable in init.
_tos supplies the loop recipients whose balances are updated unchecked.
addr is assigned to the tradeAddress whitelist state variable.
a is the arbitrary target contract of the delegatecall.
b is the arbitrary calldata executed via delegatecall.
_to is the per-iteration recipient of the unbalanced credit.
_UNI is the computed pair address compared against _from in the whitelist gate.
i drives the unbounded loop over recipient addresses.
